changeability.rationale: Most data fixes converge on helpers in api.server.ts, but several business rules (card shape, form cutoff, type-label fallback) are duplicated across the home loader and the shared paths, so some fixes must land in two to four places.

coupling.rationale: Clear layering (routes → lib + components) with explicit server/client separation via loaders and a .server.ts module; the only tangle is client components sourcing the Card type from a server module (erased at compile time, so harmless today).

evidence: app/app/lib/api.server.ts:237-251 — cardsFromPokemon with an extra() callback absorbs real variation (hidden-ability flag) without boolean creep
app/app/components/ui.tsx:36-56 — PokemonCard/CardList stretch across home, move, ability and type pages, with optional types/hidden handled by optional fields
app/app/components/move-tables.tsx:11-21 — MoveRow + COLUMNS make the sortable table data-driven, so new columns are one entry
app/app/lib/api.server.ts:66-72 — getRecord generically handles name-validated fetch + 404 mapping for all resource kinds
abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions are sized to the app's actual variation (cards with optional badges, generic record fetching, data-driven move tables) rather than speculative. The main gap is the home loader not reusing the card builder, and Card's home living in the server module.

findings.issue: Home loader constructs Card objects inline, duplicating cardsFromPokemon (app/app/lib/api.server.ts:237-251); changes to card shape or sprite provenance must land in both
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared card builder (e.g. cardFor(id, name, speciesIndex, extra)) used by both home and cardsFromPokemon

findings.issue: The alternate-form cutoff id > 10000 is duplicated in routes/home.tsx:41, so changing the exclusion rule takes two edits
findings.suggestion: Export a single isMainForm(id) (or DEFAULT_FORM_MAX) constant and use it in both places

findings.issue: The type-label fallback 'typeNames[name] ?? humanize(name)' is repeated in move.tsx:23, type.tsx:23 and home.tsx:66
findings.suggestion: Have getTypeNames return a labelFor(name) closure, or a labeledType(name) helper in api.server.ts

findings.issue: Client components type-import Card from the server module ~/lib/api.server, coupling shared UI types to server infrastructure
findings.suggestion: Move Card (and NamedRef already in format.ts) to a neutral lib/types.ts

findings.issue: spriteUrl hardcodes the media URL pattern while artwork uses API-provided URLs (routes/pokemon.tsx:57) — mixed provenance for media URLs in one app
findings.suggestion: Prefer the API's front_default when available, falling back to the constructed URL, keeping both in spriteUrl

findings.issue: Single file accumulates fetch/cache, API shapes, localization helpers and card building; adding more resources (e.g. Items) keeps growing it
findings.suggestion: Split into api/cache.ts, api/types.ts, and api/pokeapi.ts once a second consumer of the shapes appears

findings.issue: Section derives its heading id from useId, so section ids are opaque and cannot be referenced from code or tests, only the id prop is
findings.suggestion: Derive the id from the title (slug) or require an explicit id, making aria-labelledby deterministic

summary: A well-layered, idiomatic Framework-Mode app where most changes converge on a small set of helpers and shared components, and features are cheap to delete. The recurring cost is duplicated business rules between the home loader and the shared card path (card construction, form cutoff, label fallbacks), which makes some fixes land twice. Overall this is code a team can happily extend, with only localized consolidation work needed.

scenarios.change: Remove the Abilities pages and every link to them
scenarios.notes: Delete a route file and one routes.ts line, strip the Abilities section and loader field from pokemon.tsx, optionally clean getAbility/ApiAbility from api.server.ts. Nav in root.tsx never links abilities, so no unrelated edits.

scenarios.change: Fix wrong sprite for species whose default Pokémon has a different name (e.g. Deoxys)

scenarios.notes: All card lists render through CardList/PokemonCard, so a client-side sort is one edit. If sorting must respect home's server-side pagination (48/page), routes/home.tsx's loader ordering changes too.
